title: UL 10010-4 Part B: Water Cooled Chiller EPD Requirements

document.status_note: The PCR states a 5-year validity ending June 2022; ul.com PCR list shows 'Water Cooled Chillers (NA Addendum)' as expired (checked 2026-10-12).

depends_on_unavailable: UL Environment Part A: Life Cycle Assessment Calculation Rules and Report Requirements (v3.0 Dec 2017 / v3.1 Feb 2018) - indicator Tables 4-8, cut-off rules (Section 2.9), data quality (3.1.1), allocation (3.3), packaging defaults (2.8.5 Table 2), hazardous substances (4.11), RSL rules (2.8.2)
Centrifugal Chillers Average Efficiency Calculator.xlsx (UL template referenced for B6 hours and efficiency)

rules.title: Product is a water-cooled chiller
rules.requirement: The PCR covers only water-cooled packaged chillers used to cool water for air-conditioning or process cooling in commercial buildings; air-cooled chillers are out of scope.

rules.title: Product classification within CSI 23 64 00 water-cooled scope
rules.requirement: The product sub-category must be one of the listed CSI MasterFormat 23 64 xx water chiller codes; the air-cooled codes 23 64 23.13, 23 64 26.13 and 23 64 33.13 are excluded.

rules.title: EPD type is product-specific
rules.requirement: Industry-average EPDs are not covered by this PCR; declarations must be product-specific.

rules.title: EPD scope is cradle to grave
rules.requirement: The system boundary for EPDs under this PCR is cradle to grave.

rules.title: All modules A1-A5, B1-B7, C1-C4 reported
rules.requirement: Every module from product stage through end of life (A1-A5, B1-B7, C1-C4) must be reported.

rules.title: Product stage declared as A1-A3 or A1, A2, A3
rules.requirement: Modules A1, A2 and A3 may be declared individually or as one aggregated A1-A3 module.

rules.title: Module D not declared
rules.requirement: The system boundary table marks module D (benefits and loads beyond the system boundary) as not allowed for this PCR.

rules.title: Functional unit is 1 ton of chilling capacity
rules.requirement: Results are expressed per one ton (refrigeration ton) of chilling capacity.

check.expression: functional_unit.value == 1 and functional_unit.unit in ['ton chilling capacity', 'RT', 'ton of refrigeration']

rules.title: Mass of one delivered product declared
rules.requirement: The mass of one declared product (or weighted-average mass for a product group), including required installation accessories, must be stated in kg.

rules.title: Conversion factor to 1 kg declared
rules.requirement: A conversion factor between the functional unit (1 ton of capacity) and 1 kg of product must be provided.

rules.title: Conversion factor consistent with mass and capacity
rules.requirement: The kg-per-ton conversion factor should equal the delivered product mass divided by the declared chilling capacity.

rules.title: Product sub-category stated
rules.requirement: The product sub-category (per the CSI list in Section II) must be indicated alongside the functional unit.

rules.title: RSL defaults to 25 years unless substantiated
rules.requirement: A reference service life of 25 years applies unless a different value is stated and substantiated.

rules.title: RSL does not exceed building ESL
rules.requirement: The product reference service life must not be longer than the building estimated service life.

rules.title: Building ESL is 75 years
rules.requirement: The PCR assumes a 75-year building service life for replacement calculations.

rules.title: RSL and its in-use conditions declared
rules.requirement: The RSL must be declared (mandatory when B1-B7 are covered) together with the in-use conditions it relies on.

rules.title: A4 transport defaults to 500 km diesel truck
rules.requirement: Without primary data, transport from point of purchase to site is 500 km by diesel truck/trailer; any deviation must be justified.

rules.title: A4 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Transport to site must report fuel use (l/100 km), distance (km), capacity utilisation including empty runs (%), gross density of transported products (kg/m3) and capacity utilisation volume factor.

rules.title: A5 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Installation must report auxiliary materials, net freshwater use by source and fate, other resources, electricity, other energy carriers, product loss, installation waste, outputs of on-site waste processing by route, and direct emissions.

rules.title: Installation defaults to manual with no energy
rules.requirement: Without primary data, installation and deconstruction are assumed manual with no operational energy; deviations must be justified.

rules.title: B1 table reports RSL
rules.requirement: The use-stage table must report the RSL in years.

rules.title: Refrigerant loss defaults to 2% unless justified
rules.requirement: Refrigerant losses and replacement rates are assumed at 2% unless otherwise justified.

rules.title: B2 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Maintenance must report process information, cycles per RSL and per ESL, water, auxiliary materials, other resources, electricity, other energy, refrigerant replacement by type, material loss and direct emissions.

rules.title: Refrigerant replacement consistent with charge and loss rate
rules.requirement: Refrigerant replacement over the RSL should equal charge x annual loss rate x RSL.

rules.title: B3 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Repair must report repair and inspection process information, cycles per RSL and ESL, water, auxiliary materials, other resources, electricity, other energy, material loss and direct emissions.

rules.title: Replacement cycles = ESL / RSL - 1
rules.requirement: The number of replacements over the 75-year building life equals ESL divided by RSL, minus one.

rules.title: Cycles rounded up to nearest tenth
rules.requirement: Repair, replacement and refurbishment cycles, and replacements over the ESL, are rounded up to the nearest tenth (e.g. 1.47 becomes 1.5).

rules.title: B4 impacts approximately cycles x (A1-A5)
rules.requirement: Module B4 impacts correspond to the product and construction stages repeated once per replacement cycle (about twice A1-A5 with default RSL and ESL).

check.expression: abs(results.GWP.B4 - scenarios.B4.replacement_cycles * (results.GWP['A1-A3'] + results.GWP.A4 + results.GWP.A5)) <= 0.05 * abs(scenarios.B4.replacement_cycles * (results.GWP['A1-A3'] + results.GWP.A4 + results.GWP.A5))

rules.title: B4 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Replacement must report cycles, electricity, other energy, water, replaced worn parts and direct emissions.

rules.title: B5 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Refurbishment must report process description, cycles per RSL and ESL, electricity, other energy, water, material inputs, waste and direct emissions.

rules.title: B6 electricity = hours x kW/ton x tons x RSL
rules.requirement: Lifetime electricity use equals annual operating hours times efficiency (kW/ton) times chiller capacity (tons) times product life (years).

rules.title: B6 location is one of the PCR reference cities
rules.requirement: Operating hours and efficiency come from the UL calculator's weather data for the listed global reference cities, independent of the actual sales market.

rules.title: Chiller capacity equals declared nameplate capacity
rules.requirement: The capacity used in the B6 calculation is the chilling capacity declared on the product.

rules.title: Positive-displacement chillers report AHRI and actual efficiency
rules.requirement: For positive-displacement (screw, scroll, reciprocating) chillers, efficiency must be reported at both AHRI rating conditions and actual conditions.

rules.title: B6/B7 scenario table fields present
rules.requirement: Operational energy and water must report net freshwater use by source and fate, electricity, other energy carriers and equipment output (kW).

rules.title: C2 waste transport defaults to 100 km diesel truck
rules.requirement: Without primary data, transport from the building site to waste processing is 100 km by diesel truck/trailer; deviations must be justified.

rules.title: End-of-life routes table present
rules.requirement: End of life must report mass collected separately, collected as mixed waste, reused, recycled, energy recovered and landfilled.

rules.title: End-of-life routes account for product mass
rules.requirement: Reuse, recycling, energy recovery and landfill masses should together account for the delivered product mass.

check.expression: abs(scenarios.C.reuse_kg + scenarios.C.recycling_kg + scenarios.C.energy_recovery_kg + scenarios.C.landfill_kg - product.mass_per_unit_kg) <= 0.05 * product.mass_per_unit_kg

rules.title: Exported energy from waste treatment reported
rules.requirement: Net energy benefits from energy recovery declared as exported energy in C3 (R>0.6) and C4 (R<0.6), and from material flows to energy recovery, must be reported in MJ.

rules.title: Packaging declared with end-of-life pathway
rules.requirement: Each packaging material must be described by type and composition with its disposal pathway (reuse, recycling or landfill).

rules.title: Chilled capacity declared in RT
rules.requirement: Technical data must state chilled capacity in tons of refrigeration (kW optional).

rules.title: Efficiency declared in kW/ton at load and ECWT points
rules.requirement: Energy efficiency must be given in kW/ton at combinations of load percentage and entering condenser water temperature.

rules.title: Pressure drop declared
rules.requirement: Pressure drops must be given in feet of water (kPa optional).

rules.title: Rating and compliance standards listed
rules.requirement: All standards used to specify, test and approve the product (e.g. AHRI 550/590) must be listed.

rules.title: Delivered dimensions stated
rules.requirement: Dimensions and quantities of the product as delivered to site must be stated.

rules.title: Material composition as % of total mass
rules.requirement: Material composition must be disclosed as percentages (or ranges) of total product mass.

rules.title: Composition percentages total 100%
rules.requirement: Disclosed material shares should add up to the whole product.

rules.title: No 'free of' or 'harmless' claims
rules.requirement: Statements of non-inclusion such as 'free of' and interpretive claims such as 'entirely harmless' are not permitted.

rules.title: General information table complete
rules.requirement: The EPD's general information block must include program operator, program instructions and version, declaration holder, declaration number, declared product and functional unit, product definition, reference PCR and version, markets, issue date, validity period, EPD type and scope, year(s) of primary data, LCA software, LCI databases, LCIA method (each with versions), and who reviewed the PCR, conducted the LCA and verified it.

rules.title: LCA software, database and LCIA method versions stated
rules.requirement: LCA software, LCI database(s) and LCIA methodology must each be named with version numbers.

rules.title: Comparability limitation statement present
rules.requirement: The EPD must state that declarations from different programs may not be comparable and that comparisons must consider building-level use.

rules.title: Manufacturer and production sites named
rules.requirement: The manufacturing entity and place(s) of production must be given.

rules.title: Product identification with brand and image
rules.requirement: Products must be identified by brand name, material type, production code if applicable, and a photo or illustration.

rules.title: Production flow diagram included
rules.requirement: A flow diagram of the main production processes within the declared scope must be included.

rules.title: Averaging method described for product groups
rules.requirement: When several products or sites are averaged, the production-volume weighting method and represented sites must be described.

rules.title: Representative sample of up to 100 units
rules.requirement: Product-family EPDs should use a representative sample of the previous calendar year's production, up to 100 units spanning the sizes sold.

rules.title: Application, functional unit and RSL stated
rules.requirement: The intended application(s), functional unit and RSL must be stated.

rules.title: No-exclusion statement present
rules.requirement: The methodological framework must include the statement that no known flows are deliberately excluded.

any_of: no known flows are deliberately excluded

rules.title: Allocation and cut-off procedures described
rules.requirement: Allocation and cut-off procedures must be described in the methodological framework.

rules.title: Disposal channels indicated
rules.requirement: Possible disposal channels must be stated per the Part A waste classification.

rules.title: Re-use and recycling possibilities described
rules.requirement: Possibilities for re-use and recycling must be described.

rules.title: Environmental activities and certifications section
rules.requirement: Other environmental activities (e.g. recycling or take-back programs) must be described, and any listed certification must say where details can be found.

rules.title: Interpretation section present
rules.requirement: The EPD must include an interpretation discussing assumptions and limitations of the results.

rules.title: Reference PCR cited
rules.requirement: The Part B PCR the EPD is based on must be referenced.

rules.title: Period under review documented
rules.requirement: The period under review used for averages must be documented.

rules.title: Data quality evaluation provided
rules.requirement: Data quality must be evaluated for temporal, geographical and technological representativeness and completeness.

rules.title: Mass-based allocation unless justified
rules.requirement: Co-product allocation uses mass as the primary basis; other bases need a justification.

rules.title: LCIA results in scientific notation, 3 significant digits
rules.requirement: LCIA results must be declared in scientific notation with three significant digits, formatted uniformly for every indicator and module.

rules.title: SI units for all results
rules.requirement: All LCA results must be in SI units; other regional units are optional extras.

rules.title: Imperial conversions use mandated factors
rules.requirement: If imperial units are also shown, conversions must use 10.76391 ft2/m2, 2.204622 lb/kg, 947.8170 BTU/MJ, 35.31466 ft3/m3 and the stated temperature formula.

check.expression: document.conversion_factors.ft2_per_m2 == 10.76391 and document.conversion_factors.lb_per_kg == 2.204622 and document.conversion_factors.btu_per_mj == 947.8170 and document.conversion_factors.ft3_per_m3 == 35.31466

rules.title: TRACI results for North American market
rules.requirement: EPDs for North America declare LCIA results with the TRACI indicator set from Part A Table 7.
rules.applies_when: 'North America' in epd.markets or 'US' in epd.markets or 'Canada' in epd.markets

rules.title: CML results for EU market
rules.requirement: EPDs for the EU declare LCIA results with the CML indicator set from Part A Table 8.

rules.title: LCI resource, waste and carbon indicators reported
rules.requirement: Resource use indicators (Part A Table 4), output flows and waste categories (Table 5), and carbon emissions and removals (Table 6) must be reported.

rules.title: Verification type declared
rules.requirement: The EPD must state whether ISO 14025 verification was internal or external.

manual_checks.title: Capital goods included when significant
manual_checks.reason: Whether capital goods significantly affect conclusions is a judgement; software can only check that capital-goods lifetimes are documented.

manual_checks.title: Omitted aspects justified
manual_checks.reason: Adequacy of justification for any impact not covered by a module needs reviewer judgement.

manual_checks.title: Deviations from default scenarios explained
manual_checks.reason: Software checks a justification exists (default_or_justified rules); its adequacy needs review.

manual_checks.title: Confidential composition exemptions
manual_checks.reason: Withholding proprietary composition is allowed with appropriate justification; acceptability is a reviewer decision.

manual_checks.title: Health and environment measures during manufacturing and installation
manual_checks.reason: Narrative content; presence can be checked but quality cannot.

manual_checks.title: Extraordinary effects (fire, water, mechanical destruction)
manual_checks.reason: 'Should' narrative sections whose relevance depends on the product.

manual_checks.title: Supporting test documentation and detection limits
Comparisons only between similar-capacity systems
manual_checks.reason: Applies to how results are used, not to EPD content.

manual_checks.title: B6 hours and efficiency from the UL calculator
manual_checks.reason: Values must come from the UL 'Centrifugal Chillers Average Efficiency Calculator' workbook, which is not available; software can only check the formula and city list.

notes: Unit conversions in Table 1 (p.9) appear inverted in the source: it gives 'kW = 0.2843 * RT' and 'kPa = 0.3346 * ft'. Correct factors are 1 RT = 3.517 kW and 1 ft of water = 2.989 kPa (0.2843 and 0.3346 are the reciprocals). Use the correct factors in software.
Section 3.3.1 says 50 global cities but lists only 41 names (p.12). The rule uses the 41 listed names.
Existing backend/data/pcr_rules.json lists 'Frankfurt' as a B6 city; Frankfurt is not in the PCR list.
Existing backend/data/pcr_rules.json lists Module D as optional; Table 15 (p.17) marks D as 'Not allowed' for this PCR.
The 2% refrigerant loss in §2.14 does not state a time basis; it is interpreted as % of charge per year, consistent with LEED v4 Enhanced Refrigerant Management, which the PCR cites.
Indicator names, units and cut-off percentages are defined in UL Part A, which is not available, so IND rules check only that the indicator groups exist.

New field paths introduced: product.technical_data.{condenser_type, compressor_type, capacity_rt, efficiency_points[], efficiency_actual_kw_per_ton, pressure_drop_ft_water, dimensions_as_delivered, refrigerant_charge_kg}, product.classification_codes[csi], product.variants[], rsl_justification, scenarios.<module>.justification, scenarios.B1.rsl_conditions, scenarios.B2.refrigerant_loss_pct_per_year, scenarios.B6.{city, annual_operating_hours, efficiency_kw_per_ton, capacity_rt, equipment_output_kw}, scenarios.C.* (Table 13 end-of-life routes covering C1-C4), lca.averaging_method, lca.sample_size_units, results.units[], results.{resource_use, output_flows_waste, carbon_emissions_removals}, document.conversion_factors.*, document.imperial_units.
